description: The Point to Patch Convertor's dispersal for one point load: the code's contact area (or the load-derived one), the spread through surfacing and slab to the mid-plane or neutral axis, the effective patch b_eff × l_eff and its pressure, with the clause. Presets cover EN 1991-2 LM1/LM2, the UK NA, CS 454 / HB, BS 5400 and Network Rail ballast/fill. Needs no model.

alphaS.description: Half-angle from vertical through the surfacing, ° (0 is honoured).

b0.description: Contact width across the traffic, m (null = the preset's).

l0.description: Contact length along the traffic, m.

load.description: Point load, kN (needed for load-derived presets and the pressure).

neutralAxisDepth.description: m below the top, for NEUTRAL_AXIS.

presetId.description: Contact area and spread rule (EN 1991-2, UK NA, CS 454, BS 5400, Network Rail…; point_to_patch_read lists them with their clauses).

tc.description: Slab depth, m (apply: default the plate thickness).

name: point_to_patch_dispersal
title: Wheel load dispersal to a patch
